original_target.title: Cylinders for the symmetric Gaussian isoperimetric problem

scope_comparison: The October published Theorem1.18 requires eventual stabilization of the dimension profile and additional integral curvature conditions. Removing convexity does not remove these other restrictions, so it does not prove the fixed-dimensional all-volume cylinder-or-complement inequality for arbitrary symmetric competitors.
